findings: The vector is the literal regrouped product of actual one-copy amplitudes. Its partial trace factors by the finite product-of-sums identity, not an assumed density equation.
Orthogonal projection mass is obtained from the actual marginal and the bilinear trace pairing, idempotence and self-adjointness. I⊗P is proved to be an orthogonal projection.

No normalization, nonempty basis, positive copy count or invertibility is assumed. Zero copies use the empty product equal to one. Empty factors and singular reduced densities are covered by the same identities.
Substitution of an actual Schur label projector gives its mass directly; no new label projector or state model is introduced. The entropy-window and common sequence are separate results.
